Descriptions

sheet

A spreadsheet: one file per cell under in/sheet/, holding a number or a formula.

Columns

calc
Runs the calc command on the sheet.
  • error.txt: Why calc failed. Its ranges come from Positions, which the project supplies.
  • stderr.txt: A warning for each cell that divides by zero. It depends on all inputs.
  • stdout.txt: The sheet's values as CSV, one row per line. It depends on all inputs.

Its classifier, warned: Adds warned when calc writes a warning.

evaluate
Evaluates every cell of the sheet.
  • values.txt: Each cell's value, one per line, in cell order. Its ranges come from a function.

Its classifier, div-zero: Adds div-zero when some cell divides by zero.

format
Prints each formula back in canonical form.
  • formulas.txt: Each formula cell and its formula, in cell order. Its ranges come from a function.
parse
Parses every cell.
  • error.txt: The cell that is neither a number nor a formula. Its ranges come from Positions, which the project supplies.
resolve
Orders the cells so that each comes after the cells it refers to.
  • error.txt: The cycle, or the reference to a missing cell. Its ranges come from Positions, which the project supplies.

Transforms

looped
The first cell in cell order, row by row then column by column, replaced by a reference to itself, so the sheet has a cycle.

Gives circular.

renamed
Every cell moved one row down, A1 to A2, with every reference rewritten to the moved cell.

Keeps circular, dangling.

Cases only at 024a377e902519b5e8c0ac805eb791803f89e9d0

sheet/blank
A1 is a cell file with nothing in it.

Properties

circular
Some cell's formula refers back to itself, directly or through other cells.
dangling
Some formula refers to a cell the sheet doesn't have.
malformed
Some cell holds neither a number nor a formula.
